`src/Illuminate/Cache/Repository.php` (the `flexible()` method, lines 620-660) does the work. It stores each value with a total TTL and a separate "created" timestamp. Once the value is older than the fresh TTL but not yet expired, it returns the stale value immediately and defers a rebuild under a cache lock. The rebuild re-checks the created timestamp before writing, so only one rebuild wins. The other two files clean up the created-timestamp key alongside the value: `src/Illuminate/Cache/DatabaseStore.php` (`forgetMany`, `forgetManyIfExpired`) and `src/Illuminate/Cache/FileStore.php` (`forget`).
